newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat to meet Netanyahu on Tuesday over Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to meet Netanyahu on Tuesday over Hebron.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday to agree the handover of the West Bank town of Hebron to Palestinian rule, an aide to Arafat said on Monday.
"Prime minister Netanyahu and President Arafat will meet on Tuesday at 11 a.m. (0900 gmt) at Erez to finalise an agreement on Hebron," Nabil Abu Rdainah said.
"The summit will be a step towards concluding the Hebron agreement. Some issues were left to be finalised by the two leaders," Abu Rdainah told Reuters.
Israeli and Palestinian negotiators joined by U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross continued their talks in Jerusalem late on Monday in an effort to bridge the remaining gaps between the sides.
Israeli and Palestinian negotiators say progress was made in talks to break a deadlock over Hebron by Christmas.
Ross has shuttled between Israel, PLO-ruled Gaza and Egypt since his arrival on Saturday to try and clinch a deal on an Israeli troop redeployment in the town.
